name: Suspicious Person
source:
A suspicious person [spoiler]([url=/c95192]Haruna[/url]'s father)[/spoiler] who you ran into in the park.

He appears to be unemployed given how he's always working out in the park even on weekdays.

[Translated from [url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/220/article/418175]Ci-en[/url]]
